title: 孤立雪地的企鵝
source: 孤立雪地的企鵝--中文，英文.docx

zh: 孤獨於冰雪砌造的絕壁
en: Alone upon a cliff built of ice and snow
Gazing at the hazy cold fog
Holding one's breath, a thousand years of flowing light
In the posture of one standing firm between heaven and earth
Pacing through the vast haze of an ink-wash painting
The cape's bay lies still, without a ripple
On countless paths, all trace of people is gone
Can I keep you company
Watching the floating ice glide by at ease
Listening to the cold wind blow along the shore
Pondering together
The eternal emptiness of Zen's realm
The years' rising and falling of fate

zh: 《孤立雪地的企鵝》  by  KL Ho
en: "A Lonely Penguin In The Snow"  by  KL Ho

zh: 孤獨於冰雪砌造的絕壁
en: I won't ask why you strayed from the herd
Alone upon a cliff built of ice and snow
Gazing at the hazy cold fog
Holding one's breath, a thousand years of flowing light
In the posture of one standing firm between heaven and earth
Pacing through the emptiness of an ink-wash painting
The cape's bay lies still, without a ripple
On countless paths, all human traces vanish
Whether I may keep you company
Watching the floating ice glide by at ease
Listening to the cold wind blow from every direction
Pondering
The eternal emptiness of Zen's realm
The rise and fall of human affinities

zh: " A Lonely Penguin In The Snow "    by KL Ho
en: " A Lonely Penguin In The Snow "    by KL Ho

zh: I don't ask why you ran away from the group
Alone on a cliff made of ice and snow

Wandering in the void of ink painting
en: I don't ask why you ran away from the group
Alone on a cliff made of ice and snow
Staring at the misty cold fog
Hold your breath, millennium streamer
Stand on the ground
Wandering in the void of ink painting

zh: From path to path, no man in sight
Watch the ice floes slide by leisurely
Listen to the cold wind blowing everywhere
The eternal Zen realm is empty
The origin and fall of the world
en: Quiet Bay
From path to path, no man in sight
Can I accompany you
Watch the ice floes slide by leisurely
Listen to the cold wind blowing everywhere
Pondering
The eternal Zen realm is empty
The origin and fall of the world
